summary.zh: Google Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 文生图上线，按 resolution 每张固定价：1K $0.034、2K $0.051、4K $0.114；默认 2K。
summary.en: Google Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 text-to-image is live, fixed per-image price by resolution: 1K $0.034, 2K $0.051, 4K $0.114; defaults to 2K.

body.zh:
## Nano Banana 2.1

**Nano Banana 2.1** 已在 OmniMux 上线。

- **Model ID:** `nano-banana-2-1`
- **API:** `POST /v1/images/generations`（异步，返回 `task_id`）
- **计费:** 1K 每张 $0.034、2K 每张 $0.051、4K 每张 $0.114；默认 2K；`n` 固定为 1
- **能力:** MVP 文生图；参考图/图生图与 `model_params` 暂不支持（400）
body.en:
## Nano Banana 2.1

**Nano Banana 2.1** is now available on OmniMux.

- **Model ID:** `nano-banana-2-1`
- **API:** `POST /v1/images/generations` (async, returns `task_id`)
- **Billing:** 1K at $0.034, 2K at $0.051, 4K at $0.114 per image; defaults to 2K; `n` fixed at 1
- **Capability:** MVP text-to-image; reference image / image-to-image and `model_params` not supported yet (400)
